response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software developer with 16+ years of experience, he lacks critical required qualifications for this embedded security role. Most critically, C programming proficiency and native Japanese language skills are mandatory requirements that are not present. His career has been focused on web, cloud, and full-stack development rather than embedded systems, security technologies, or network switch products. He demonstrates no experience with required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption systems), embedded networking protocols, or Linux kernel development—all essential for this position.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (16+ years) with demonstrated expertise in software craftsmanship, testing, and code quality
Proven ability to work across diverse technical domains and learn new technologies quickly
Fluent English speaker with Linux system experience and solid software development fundamentals
concerns: Does not possess C programming proficiency (required skill); most recent C/C++ work was at National Instruments in 2014-2015, over a decade ago
No native Japanese language capability; only speaks English, Romanian, and basic German (required qualification explicitly stated)
Career trajectory is web/cloud development (Node.js, TypeScript, React, AWS); no background in embedded systems, security technologies, network switches, or firmware development

key_factors.factor: No Embedded Security or Networking Background
